summary: Backport pull requests for dependency upgrades have been submitted and are being reviewed. The discussion focuses on finalizing the release process and ensuring all updates are compatible. The discussion centers on adding a new numeric vector type to Parquet and its impact on backward compatibility. Participants worry that requiring an annotation would fragment existing unannotated list data, making many Iceberg tables unusable without rewriting.
